issues.jp_before: 事故[じこ]{の|no-possessive}{せいで|seide}、道[みち]{が|ga-subject}込[こ]んでいます。
issues.problem: 込む is a nonstandard spelling for congested roads; 混む is standard.
issues.action: Changed 込[こ]んで to 混[こ]んで.

issues.jp_before: 田中[たなか]さん{が|ga-subject}休[やす]んだ{せいで|seide}、私[わたし]{が/は|ga-subject}残業[ざんぎょう]{を|o-object}しました。
issues.problem: English 'had to work overtime' adds an obligation the Japanese lacks.
issues.action: English changed to 'Because Mr. Tanaka took the day off, I worked overtime.'

issues.jp_before: エアコン{の|no-possessive}{せいで|seide}、部屋[へや]{が|ga-subject}寒[さむ]すぎます。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 冷房のせいで item (air conditioning as the culprit).
issues.action: Rewrote as 強[つよ]い風[かぜ]{の|no-possessive}{せいで|seide}、傘[かさ]{が|ga-subject}壊[こわ]れました。 (umbrella broke because of the strong wind).

issues.jp_before: 忘[わす]れ物[もの]{を|o-object}した{せいで|seide}、家[いえ]{に/へ|ni-destination}戻[もど]りました。
issues.problem: English 'had to go back' adds an obligation the Japanese lacks.
issues.action: English changed to 'I went back home.'

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{が|ga-subject}余計[よけい]なことを言[い]った{せいで|seide}、みんな{が/は|ga-subject}怒[おこ]りました。
issues.problem: The object particle を after 余計なこと was not marked as a slot.
issues.action: Marked {を|o-object} and moved the focus index from 1 to 2.

issues.problem: 去年 was used as the baseline in four items; low variety.
issues.action: Changed the baseline to 先月[せんげつ] (last month), with the English and why updated to match.

issues.jp_before: 去年[きょねん]{に比[くら]べて/と比[くら]べて|nikurabete}、客[きゃく]{の|no-possessive}数[かず]{が|ga-subject}二倍[にばい]{に|ni-change}なりました。
issues.problem: 去年 was used as the baseline in four items; low variety.
issues.action: Changed the baseline to オープン当時[とうじ] (when we first opened), with the English and why updated to match.
